the combination of ABT-88 and TMZ is well tolerated, and does not improve survival in recurrent TMZ refractive glioblastoma.
ABT-2888 in combination with temazolamide did not improve progression free or overall survival compared to temozolomides alone.

the combination of ABT-88 with TMZ is feasible, but does not improve PFS in recurrent glioblastoma.
